claim: Tiny diffraction cameras replace most lenses
originalWording: Tiny diffraction cameras replace most lenses

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: P02 2019 computing, quantum-based diffraction imaging paragraph

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: The specified pinhead-scale lensless/diffraction technology replaces most conventional camera lenses.
reference.rationale: Ordinary smartphone cameras still relied on lenses in 2019; tiny camera sensors did not fulfill the optical substitution. Computational imaging is widespread, but not equivalent to majority replacement of optics with the specified diffraction architecture.
